sn23.17:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Rādho Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Anattā anattā ti bhante vuccati || || Katamo nu kho bhante anattāti || || Rūpaṃ kho Rādha anattā || vedanā anattā || saññā || saṅkhārā anattā || viññāṇam anattāti || || Evam passaṃ || pe || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
